title: aadi1011/AI-ML-Roadmap-from-scratch
summary: A comprehensive learning roadmap repository covering AI, ML, Generative AI, Deep Learning, Data Science, NLP, and Reinforcement Learning from beginner to advanced levels. It serves as a structured guide for anyone wanting to build AI/ML skills from scratch.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of navigating the complex and vast landscape of AI/ML learning by providing a structured 0 to 100 curriculum.
why_valuable: Offers an organized, all-in-one resource that eliminates decision fatigue for learners by consolidating paths for multiple AI subfields into a single roadmap.
